capabilities: run Claude Code, Antigravity or a shell in Obsidian panels
send the open note and selected text to the AI as context
apply AI edits to notes live in the editor
snapshot notes before each AI message so changes can be undone
paste screenshots into the AI panel
disambiguation: Not a general terminal emulator; the shell panel is optional and the point is chatting with an AI about your notes.
extras: macOS only (Obsidian desktop 1.13+); the plugin is free but Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan or API credits; notes read by the AI are sent to Anthropic or Google, which the README flags as a privacy limit; full user guide lives outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run an AI assistant that sees the open note and selection and can edit notes directly from a panel.

relations.evidence: Claude Code, Antigravity or a shell open as panels, like any other tab.
